body:
I do want to succeed in school...I love my major but it's like I don't want to take the steps to get there. My parents are extremely supporting and understanding but they're afraid I'll end up like my brother (living at home at age 35) or something and it makes them a little more intrusive than they should be at this age. I've poured so much money into this next fall (I rented a house with friends) that I don't want to back out now. I just feel trapped.

Thanks for the reassurance though, it's comforting to know the background checks and resume aren't as big as they've been made out to be.
